rendered: The binary bacterial mixtures were made at volumetric ratios of 1:0, 1:4, 1:8, and 0:1[1], and the sensor array was able to tell them apart (Fig. 4[2]a–c). For the multicomponent tests, the ternary mixtures (A + B + C) were used at a compositional ratio of 1:1:1[3] (Fig. 4[4]d–f). The same sentence also lists additional binary mixtures (A + B) in that part of the experiment.
